sentencePolicy: Complete summary if it fits; otherwise first intact sentence if it fits, else second intact sentence. Never rewrite or cut inside a sentence.
layoutNotes: Story #4 attribution is in its kicker row so one intact sentence fits at 9 px.
Actual rounded cell bounds retain a minimum one-pixel inter-letter gap.
Up to five 9 px lines fit some specified summary boxes without exceeding their pixel bounds.
After the first full render, headlines were balanced over two measured lines to remove orphans without changing words or sizes.

summaries.title: Cyclone Akvan slams eastern India coast
retainedSentences: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha around 8 am with sustained winds of 70 to 90 km/h.
Authorities evacuated more than 300,000 residents into 9,341 shelters and deployed 423 rescue teams across vulnerable coastal districts.
